## Go through my Xero transactions

Starts a review in the background and answers straight away, because the
review takes minutes and the chat cannot wait that long. It never returns
suggestions: `get_reconciliation_suggestions` does that once the review
has finished.

It refuses three ways, all of them on purpose: with no bookkeeping profile
saved, with no Xero connection, and while another review is already
running.
